Advertisement for Faculty
Thursday, 20 November 2014
6859 Hits
Applications along with complete bio-data and necessary academic certificates/testimonials with names of 2 referees are invited for the following posts. The applicant should report to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS). The candidates are also invited for a walk in Interview alongwith application and supporting documents at 10 A.M on any working day. The appointments would be adhoc till the Selection Committee meets.
Professor in TB & Chest
Assistant Professor in Psychiatry, Radiodiagnosis, Paediatrics, Oncology, Orthopaedics, Oncosurgery & Cardiology, Gen. Surgery, Ophthalmology, Obst & Gynae
Sr. Resident in Medicine, Surgery, Anaesthesiology, Radiodiagnosis, TB & Chest & Paediatrics, Obst & Gynae, Orthopaedics, Psychiatry
Qualification: As per the Medical Council of India norms.
Pay Scale
Professors/Assistant Professor:  As per rules (6th Pay Commission)
Senior Resident: Consolidated Salary of Rs. 42140/- per month.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
